name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> name. Descriptor accurately describes the two-step body: fd2_composite_battle_frame(0) then fd2_animate_spell_projectile_paths(). No address residue, no domain-ID confusion. Both callee names verified live in Ghidra (0x11cac=fd2_composite_battle_frame, 0x1df58=fd2_animate_spell_projectile_paths).
purpose: Spell-finale helper: recomposite the battle frame and run the queued spell projectile-path animation; the common tail of every offensive/heal spell handler.
logic_summary: Two sequential calls: fd2_composite_battle_frame(0) (skip_palette_cycle=0, advance palette this frame), then fd2_animate_spell_projectile_paths() (no args). Asm body 0x21190..0x2119f (PUSH 0; CALL 0x11cac; ADD ESP,4; CALL 0x1df58). Immediately followed by a shared Watcom epilogue 0x2119f..0x211a3 (POP EBP/EDI/ESI/EBX; RET) that restores the *parent's* saved registers. Every reaching edge into 0x21190 is a tail-JMP (4 conditional JGE early-exits + 2 unconditional terminal JMPs), never a CALL, so the body and the parent register-restore are physically shared in the binary. The six reaching parents (verified live via xrefs) are fd2_apply_attack_spell_damage (0x2116c JGE), fd2_cast_group_hp_heal_spell (0x21204 JMP), fd2_execute_offensive_targeted_spell (0x2128e JGE), fd2_execute_offensive_targeted_spell_variant_b (0x21320 JGE), fd2_execute_offensive_full_screen_flash_spell (0x2141e JGE), fd2_dispatch_variant_b_cast (0x21b94 JMP). Layer-2 equivalent: emit only the body as a plain no-arg helper; the compiler regenerates each parent's own register-restore epilogue, exactly matching the shared POP sequence.

returns.semantics: No return value. In the binary, control falls through into a shared 4-register POP + RET that returns to the tail-jumping parent's caller.

comment_original_issue: Minor cosmetic only: source comment annotates 'Body (asm 0x21190..0x2119f)' and 'epilogue (0x211A0..0x211A3)', but the first POP (POP EBP) actually sits at 0x2119f (the CALL animate occupies 0x2119a..0x2119e). This is a byte-boundary nuance in an illustrative address range, not a semantic error; the comment substance (composite+animate body, then shared register-restore epilogue) is correct. Left as-is.
notes: Decompilation, signature (param_count=0), disassembly, all 6 xrefs, and both callee function names verified live in Ghidra and consistent with the existing src comment and Ghidra plate. Name kept, comment kept, plate untouched. Only the shard file is staged; src/gfx/rndscene.c is unchanged.
